Only the new test file was added; the pre-existing deletion of `CSVParserTest.java` was already present before I started. Build passes with `mvn test -Dtest=CSVParserAgentTest`: 42 tests, all green.

Summary of `CSVParserAgentTest` (`src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVParserAgentTest.java`), covering `CSVParser`'s public API:
- Factory methods: `parse(String,...)`, `parse(Reader,...)`, `parse(File,...)`, `parse(Path,...)`, `parse(InputStream,...)`, `parse(URL,...)`, `builder()`, and the deprecated constructors — including `NullPointerException` for null `file`/`path`/`string`/`url` args and null-format defaulting.
- Header handling: auto-detected vs. explicit headers, `setSkipHeaderRecord`, duplicate-header and missing-column-name validation (`DuplicateHeaderMode`, `setAllowMissingColumnNames`), `getHeaderMap`/`getHeaderNames` (including that the returned map is an independent copy).
- Record iteration: `iterator()`, `stream()`, `getRecords()`, `getRecordNumber()`, `getCurrentLineNumber()`, `getFirstEndOfLine()`, partial-consumption behavior, `Iterator.remove()` throwing `UnsupportedOperationException`, `NoSuchElementException` at end-of-stream and after `close()`.
- Comments: header/trailer comment detection (`hasHeaderComment`, `getHeaderComment`, `hasTrailerComment`, `getTrailerComment`).
- `close()`/`isClosed()`, and `CSVFormat.Builder.setMaxRows()` limiting output.
